releaseNotes: Sanetra v2.0.0 migrates the Android application identity to com.sanetra.assistivevision with permanent release signing, adds package-migration detection in the update checker, and updates all 31 documentation figures in a unified publication-quality visual design. Users upgrading from v1.0.0 (com.visionassistant.vision_assistant.visionmission) must install v2.0.0 as a fresh app.
